t: The Magnusson folding hand truck is a robust solution for transporting heavy or bulky items efficiently. Featuring a telescopic handle and a large base plate, it offers comfortable handling and secure placement of loads up to 120kg. Its durable, rust-proof aluminium and steel construction ensures longevity, while heavy-duty rubber wheels provide smooth movement across various surfaces. This compact hand truck is ideal for construction site logistics, workshop organisation, or deliveries, allowing trade professionals to move tools and materials with ease. A bungee cord is included to safely secure goods during transit, making it a reliable choice for daily use and storage in tight spaces.
